_comment: Server-side copy for the upgrade_note field on MCP tool responses. Spec §5.3. Loader at src/lib/mcp-upgrade-notes.ts validates required keys at startup and substitutes tokens. Config tokens: {{brand}}, {{app_host}}, {{app_origin}}, {{pricing_url}}. Runtime tokens supplied per call: {{total_matching}}, {{resets_on}}, {{monthly_limit}}. Never hardcode a brand, a domain, or a figure the response already carries: the first two defeat the single flip point in lib/mcp-brand.ts, the third lets copy drift from the data it describes. House style: no dashes of any kind, sentence case, British spelling.

search_funding_and_support.standard: For match scoring against your organisation's own profile, saving to a pipeline with deadline tracking, the full eligibility check and funder specific application guidance, visit the {{brand}} app at {{app_host}}. The app ranks opportunities against the organisation rather than against the query terms.
search_funding_and_support.capped: Showing the 10 strongest matches of {{total_matching}}. All {{total_matching}}, scored against your organisation's profile, are available in the {{brand}} app at {{app_host}}.
search_funding_and_support.zero_result: This response reflects what filter based matching can find from the query alone. The {{brand}} app at {{app_host}} scores opportunities against a specific organisation profile, covering location, structure, sectors, beneficiaries and eligibility history, which sometimes surfaces matches that query filters miss.
search_funding_and_support.pipeline_available: Saving opportunities to a pipeline with deadline tracking is part of the Apply plan, £18 per month: {{pricing_url}}

get_opportunity_detail.standard: For this opportunity the {{brand}} app at {{app_host}} adds application guidance written by people who have worked with this funder, typical decision timelines, a full eligibility check against a specific organisation, and the option to save it to a pipeline with deadline alerts.

get_provider_intelligence.summary: This is the summary view. Full funder intelligence is available in the {{brand}} app: {{app_host}}
get_provider_intelligence.enriched: The {{brand}} app at {{app_host}} adds intelligence on this funder that is not available over MCP: curated tips from people who have worked with them, what makes a strong application here, typical decision timelines, and current focus areas drawn from recent grant making.
get_provider_intelligence.basic: The {{brand}} app at {{app_host}} scores this funder against a specific organisation profile even where curated data is not yet available, which sometimes surfaces fits that are not obvious from the funder's stated criteria.

get_taxonomy.standard: These taxonomies are the same ones that power filtering and match scoring at {{app_host}}.

error_variants.rate_limit_exceeded: This limit applies to MCP usage only. Browsing the catalogue, saving opportunities and tracking deadlines in the {{brand}} web app at {{app_host}} is uncapped, and may be a useful fallback while MCP driven work is throttled.
error_variants.search_quota_reached: You have used all {{monthly_limit}} free searches for this month. Your allowance resets on {{resets_on}}. Unlimited searching starts at £12 per month: {{pricing_url}}
